project.name: osgi/domains/incus
project.description: The incus domain: the external contacts toward an Incus host. Its first content is the instance-reachability contact (incus-port declares the verb, incus-edge shells `ssh … incus exec` via ProcessBuilder), extracted from the host SeedSystemdAdapterEndpointGate that was marked @Transitional(to="incus-edge"). The host keeps the readiness orchestration and composes this contact from the registry — the same shape as the shipped dbus-systemd and cluster edges.
